Question: Riya has 3 boxes with 8 pencils in each box. She gives away 5 pencils. How many pencils does she have left?
Solution: 3 boxes of 8 pencils make $3 \times 8 = 24$ pencils. After giving away 5, she has $24 - 5 = 19$ pencils.
